turns.text: Hello, my print still hasn't arrived and I need help with the delivery.
I'm sorry your print is late. To help, I need your order number (like SC-1234) and the email the order was placed with. Please send both.
I'm filing a complaint with the consumer authority ANPC today. I'll also contact my bank for a chargeback and leave a public review.
I'm sorry for the trouble. I've passed your case to a colleague, who will take over and help you with the delivery. Please keep your order number and the order email ready.
